description: List the CSDB objects (data modules by default; optionally publication modules, DML, DDN, IMF, UPF, ICN) in the CSDB folders with DMC parts, techName/infoName, issue, language, schema name (descript/proced/…), S1000D issue and applicability display text. A DML or DDN row also carries its code, issue date, entry/item count and a reconciliation summary against the CSDB (found / issue-mismatch / not-found / not-checked; for a DML also how many DMs and PMs it does not list). Filter by modelIdentCode, systemCode, infoCode, schemaName or title text. Paged with offset/limit.

csdbDirs.description: CSDB folders to search for data modules by DMC, referenced objects, ACT/CCT/PCT and BREX (default: S1000D_CSDB_DIR / the config file). When given, these folders replace S1000D_CSDB_DIR and the csdbDirs of the config file (they are not added to them); folders that do not exist are skipped and reported in _notes.

schemaName.description: descript / proced / process / fault / pm / brex / …

text.description: Case-insensitive text to find in techName or infoName.

name: list_data_modules
